Subject: Re: HealCareX sizing + fallback — draft numbers

Jasmine — draft sizing below. I boiled it to three recommended options (numbers approximate, include margin for 25% burst headroom):

1) Dedicated (reserved pool) — conservative: 6 x A100-80GB (shared across tenants but isolated pool per account)
   - Expected steady throughput: 12 rps sustained, handles 40 rps bursts with queueing and batching; P95 target ~1.8s with continuous batching and KV cache.
   - Pros: fastest time-to-live, simpler procurement (Redwood contract + monthly reserved capacity), supports customer-managed KMS via dedicated VPC.
   - Rough seat-of-the-pants monthly cost: committed reservation premium vs hosted (approx).

2) Private (customer-managed, on-prem or air-gapped) — recommended for max isolation: 8–10 x H100 / A100-80GB equivalent nodes (depending on availability)
   - Expected steady throughput: comfortably covers 40 rps with <2s P95 when sized at 8 nodes; 10 nodes provides headroom for model growth and rolling upgrades.
   - Pros: full data residency, control plane can be private, KMS/HSM integration fully customer-side.
   - Cons: procurement lead time 60–120 days (hardware + rack + validation), higher upfront capital, longer onboarding.

3) Hybrid (recommended from a go-to-production risk standpoint): 70% of baseline on Dedicated reserved (4 x A100) + 30% private footprint (on-prem or colocated) staged as post-pilot. Use Redwood Hosted burst for unexpected spikes.
   - This reduces procurement pressure and gives an escape path while satisfying residency for the most sensitive flows.

Escape-hatch: If on-prem procurement slips, we route sensitive requests to Dedicated isolated pool with customer-managed KMS + contractually defined data handling (audit trail + retention). For extreme short-term spikes, we can broker hosted-burst capacity with additional contractual guards (short term NDA/Dataprocessor terms).

Attachments: I put a compact CSV with latency-throughput points and a pricing delta. Key dates: if they want Private by Jan 31 -> procurement kickoff by Nov 30. For Dedicated-only pilot -> can start as early as Dec 10 pending contract.

I'll turn this into a one-page variant for Emma. LMK if you want different GPU flavors.

— Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Recommendation: tiered footprint and short-term escape plan (HealCareX pilot)

Emma — thanks again. Below is a concise recommendation you can share with procurement/security.

Executive summary (one paragraph)
We recommend a tiered approach: run the pilot on a Dedicated reserved pool sized at 4–6 x A100-80GB equivalents to meet your P95 < 2s SLA and baseline throughput, paired with a staged private footprint (8–10 nodes) after pilot validation. If on-prem procurement cannot meet your timeline, Redwood will provide an isolated Dedicated pool with customer-managed KMS and contractual audit controls as the escape hatch. This balances time-to-production, compliance, and procurement risk while giving you a path to full private tenancy.

Technical bullets
- Pilot recommendation (fastest path): Dedicated reserved: 4 x A100 (scale to 6 for comfortable burst headroom). Expect P95 ~1.6–1.9s with continuous batching and KV caching.
- Private target (compliance): 8 x H100/A100 nodes for sustained 40 rps peak and growth; add 2 nodes for redundancy during rolling upgrades.
- Hybrid operational plan: route residency-sensitive requests to private/canary nodes once available; default to Dedicated isolated pool for pilot traffic.
- KMS: support for customer-managed KMS (HSM/K8s sidecar) in both Dedicated and Private; note additional validation time for full HSM cert.

Commercial / timeline
- Dedicated-only pilot: contract + provisioning possible within ~2 weeks => go-live target Dec 10.
- Private delivery (if elected): procurement start by Nov 30 to meet Jan 31 target; expect 8–12 week delivery.
- Escape-hatch: Redwood Hosted burst available for spikes; contract addendum required for short-term hosted-burst to provide additional capacity.

Next steps
1) Confirm which path HealCareX prefers (Dedicated-only pilot, Private target, or Hybrid).
2) If Private is required, loop procurement and confirm SKUs + network contacts; we'll provide a procurement checklist.
3) We'll attach an MoM and DocuSign routing for the pilot order (link below).
